title: Zuri's Watering Blooms Day
description: Join Zuri, Kofi, and Nala as they care for their beautiful flowers! They'll water them every day to make them strong and happy.
characters: Three adorable Black toddlers: Zuri, Kofi and Nala, in their established looks.

lines: Zuri's flowers need it to grow with care.
Kofi and Nala too can help us share!
verses.scene: Zuri stands by the garden tub, pouring water on the flowers while Kofi and Nala watch.

lines: We'll use our cups to pour with fun!
Every flower will get some water soon.
verses.scene: Kofi and Zuri hand each other small watering cans, taking turns pouring water on the flowers while Nala supervises.

lines: We'll make our flowers happy too!
Watering them is fun to do.
verses.scene: All three toddlers are gathered around the garden, clapping and cheering each other on as they finish watering their plants.
